description: SvTagsInput in Svelte 5 as a token editor: type and press Enter or comma to add a chip, Backspace or the chip's x to remove one, with unique values and a max count enforced, shown as a skills field and an email recipients field with validation.

faq.question: How do I limit the number of tags?
faq.answer: Set max. Once it is reached the input stops accepting new tokens until one is removed, and the count can be shown in the hint.

faq.question: Can I validate each tag?
faq.answer: Yes. Check the array in onChange and reject entries that fail, for example invalid email addresses, and pass invalid with an error message to show it.

faq.question: Are duplicates allowed?
faq.answer: No. Adding a value that already exists is ignored, so the array is always unique.
